* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar CRASH.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Snail Trail|Snail Trail]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Triads.png]]CJ's garage, Doherty, San Fierro

After the cutscene, your current pistol (if any) is replaced by a Silenced Pistol. Now head to Jizzy's club. The bouncers will not let you in, so climb up the plank by one of the supports of the Gant Bridge. Jump off onto the roof, and enter the skylight. Once inside, head downstairs to trigger a cutscene. After this, Jizzy makes a run for it. Take out the guards if you want, but head for the door. Follow Jizzy in the car, take him out, then grab the phone off the corpse to complete the mission.

== Tips ==
You can avoid losing health with the jump to the roof if you use a motorbike to get all the way up, and then fall to the roof while still on the bike.

Jizzy will escape in a blue Pimpmobile, which you will see parked outside the club when you arrive, next to a black Stretch. You can pop the tires (or do whatever creative things to it)  outside before entering the club. When Jizzy escapes, the damage will still be in effect, and Jizzy won't get very far. '''Do not''' crash it into the water; he will get in the car in the water, and the phone will be destroyed.

If you destroy the car, he will leave on a uniquely colored green Pizzaboy, making it VERY easy to kill him without blowing up the cell phone.

Once inside, you will be on a scaffold. You don't need to take the time to go around to the first floor; jump from the scaffold, and you will trigger the next cutscene.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $12,000
* '''Respect''': +30
